title: Jaap van Ede, PhD (Editor-in-Chief, Procesverbeteren.nl / Business-Improvement.eu) — in-depth Incorruptible review: 'a kind of multi-layered firewall'
summary: Jaap van Ede — PhD Editor-in-Chief of Procesverbeteren.nl and Business-Improvement.eu, Dutch continuous-improvement publications on Lean, Agile and Smart operations — publishes a full-length review of Incorruptible with Ries's central metaphors intact: financial gravity, mission lock, and a multi-layered firewall of three external + three internal protective measures. Concludes the book resonates strongly with Lean-focused companies.
blockquote: Eric Ries calls the "shareholders first" phenomenon #FinancialGravity. His new book #Incorruptable about this, is full of business horror. But it doesn't have to be that way, and this makes the book hopeful! Eric Ries is best known for his book The Lean Startup. In Incorruptable, he shows how to safeguard a customer-focused #mission. Ries proposes a kind of multi-layered firewall, that not only protects a company mission like a fortress, but even makes the mission leading. The fortress consists of three building blocks for external protection, and three for internal protection.
